restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่-ลำพูนสัตวแพทย์ (หนองหอย)
text: This vet told me I had to wait for my kittens to be 1 years old before you can sterilise them and that the females had to be on birth control until then. I think they are lying to make more money or are massively uninformed and incompetent. You can sterilise kittens at about 4 months old. Either way I recommend you find a more trustworthy or competent vet. Birth control can be very harmful to your cats as well, there are serious side effects. Also do your own internet research about everything! I have learned that I can't just rely on the advice of my vet.

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่-ลำพูนสัตวแพทย์ (หนองหอย)
text:
I took my cat to the vet on the evening of January 28th (2025) for sterilization. At the counter, a thin male staff member checked her medical history and confirmed that she was fully vaccinated, having just received her last vaccination on January 6th. He said we could bring her in right away. I double-checked, confirming the last vaccination was on January 6th, and he confirmed it. I then asked if there were any available slots the following day, and he said yes, no problem.

I even asked if we could bring her in for a blood test that evening, and he said yes, no problem.

However, on the morning of the 29th, the same staff member said we hadn't booked an appointment and raised his voice, saying we had only been in a consultation the previous day.

He checked again and said our cat couldn't be sterilized yet because she hadn't received her January 6th vaccination, which was her scheduled date.

I'm so confused! Why didn't you inform me that yesterday? Yesterday you said we could do it right away, that she was fully vaccinated, and that we could bring her in for a blood test that evening as there were available slots.

The staff member was incredibly clueless, unprofessional, careless, and lacked thoroughness, wasting my time. He also spoke rudely despite it being his own fault. I feel sorry for the children who had to go without food because of the staff's negligence. It's terrible.

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่-ลำพูนสัตวแพทย์ (หนองหอย)
text:
I took my cat to this vet for general services like vaccinations and anti-diarrhea injections. The treatment costs were reasonable, but they didn't give me a receipt unless I asked for it. I wouldn't recommend it if my cat was seriously ill. My cat had a severe lung infection. The vet injected saline and antibiotics under the skin and drew blood. They sent us home, but the saline solution kept draining from the injection site. By evening, her condition worsened, and she passed away at 5 am.
Therefore, if your cat is seriously ill, it's better to go to a vet clinic that admits the cat for treatment.

restaurant_name: เชียงใหม่-ลำพูนสัตวแพทย์ (หนองหอย)
text: I took my cat to the vet because she was meowing loudly and unusually, which wasn't normal. She seemed to have a sore mouth. The vet took her temperature and briefly examined her mouth. She cried when she opened her mouth, then immediately closed it again. In short, the vet said she was fine, just old and maybe a picky eater. The vet and assistant even tried to sell us food related to liver and kidneys, so we thought she was okay. Later, she started drooling, so we took her to another clinic (it turned out she needed emergency surgery; she had oral cancer). The other vet said they felt sorry for her and wondered how she had endured it so long. Ultimately, she didn't have much time left with us. We are heartbroken. If we had known sooner, it would have been better to have her treated in time.
